dish.title: Colombian Ajiaco Chicken and Three-Potato Soup
dish.description: Bogota's comforting chicken soup: chicken thighs simmered with three kinds of potatoes until the russets melt and thicken the broth, with corn on the cob and dried guascas herb, finished with sour cream, capers, and avocado.

recipe_version.title: Colombian Ajiaco Chicken and Three-Potato Soup
recipe_version.description: Bogota's comforting chicken soup: chicken thighs simmered with three kinds of potatoes until the russets melt and thicken the broth, with corn on the cob and dried guascas herb, finished with sour cream, capers, and avocado.

steps.title: Prep
steps.body: Peel and thinly slice the russets; peel and cut the Yukon Golds; cut the red potatoes; cut each ear of corn into 3 pieces; trim the scallions and smash the garlic.

steps.title: Bring to a boil
steps.body: Put the chicken, russets, scallions, garlic, salt, stock, and the 2 cups water in the 6-quart pot and bring to a boil over high.

steps.title: Simmer the chicken
steps.body: Simmer on medium-low, partly covered, until the chicken is tender and the russets start to break down, 30 minutes. Remove the chicken and scallions.

steps.title: Add potatoes, corn, and guascas
steps.body: Add the Yukon Golds, red potatoes, corn, and guascas and simmer, stirring now and then, until the potatoes are tender and the russets have dissolved into the broth, 20 minutes.

steps.title: Shred the chicken
steps.body: While the potatoes cook, pull the chicken from the bones with 2 forks and discard the bones (overlap stated).

steps.title: Finish and serve
steps.body: Return the chicken, simmer 3 minutes, and taste for salt. Ladle into bowls with a piece of corn each and serve with sour cream, capers, avocado, and cilantro.
